title: Rate Plan Note: Member and Corporate Discount on the Weekly Parking Maximum (Guest Folios)
content:
Reservations on the Member Flexible Rate or the Corporate Negotiated Rate of Room Reservations carry a lower weekly parking maximum on Guest Folios.

**Note.** Rate-plan maximum discount: a reservation on the Member Flexible Rate lowers the stay's parking maximum by the member-rate maximum discount percent of 2%, one on the Corporate Negotiated Rate by the corporate-rate maximum discount percent of 1%, and one on any other rate plan not at all; the discount acts on the maximum the method gives and before it is rounded.

The rate plan is the rate plan on the Room Reservations record of the reservation behind the folio.

| Rate plan on the Room Reservations record | Discount on the stay's parking maximum |
|---|---|
| Member Flexible Rate | 2% |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | 1% |
| Any other rate plan | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical maximum of $308.571… before rounding)

- **Member Flexible Rate.** Lowered by 2%: $308.571… times 98% is $302.400; rounded half up to the cent, $302.40.
- **Corporate Negotiated Rate.** Lowered by 1%: $308.571… times 99% is $305.486; rounded half up to the cent, $305.49.
- **Flexible Rate.** Not lowered: $308.57.

The discount is taken on the unrounded maximum, and the rounding to the cent follows it.
